comment: Minimum PASSING test count per workspace, checked by scripts/check-test-floor.mjs. This is a RATCHET against a suite that silently shrinks, not a coverage target. It exists because `--experimental-test-isolation=none` (see .github/workflows/ci.yml) swallows a module-level throw once any test in that file has registered: the run goes green, exits 0, and simply reports fewer tests. Measured: 2174 instead of 2175, with `# fail 0`. A count floor is the only thing that turns that back into a red. Raise these when tests are added; lowering one is a deliberate act that should be explained in the commit. LOWERED 2026-08-19: backthread 729 -> 714 (712 after the removal, +3 for the retired-name tests: two behavioural, one over its source). The pre-edit PreToolUse hook was removed (founder decision, see cli/hooks/hooks.json's $comment_no_pretooluse_edit), retiring editNudge.test.ts's 15 tests and 2 `edit-context` dispatch tests in bin.test.ts. The suite shrank because the feature did, not because tests were dropped: the case that pinned the hook's existence was INVERTED into a guard in plugin.test.ts rather than deleted. RAISED 2026-08-19: @backthread/extractor 2175 -> 2201 for packages/extractor/src/safety.test.ts — the source-tree budget and its symlink-escape guard, which previously had no test that failed when it broke.
